```yaml
name: Comment Artifacts

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['test-build.yml']
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  comment-artifacts:
    if: github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Find PR number
        id: find-pr
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          GITHUB_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          GITHUB_HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
          GITHUB_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          GITHUB_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        with:
          script: |
            const headSha = process.env.GITHUB_HEAD_SHA;
            const headBranch = process.env.GITHUB_HEAD_BRANCH;
            const owner = process.env.GITHUB_OWNER;
            const repo = process.env.GITHUB_REPO;
            const pulls = await github.rest.pulls.list({
              owner,
              repo,
              head: `${owner}:${headBranch}`,
              state: 'open'
            });
            const pr = pulls.data.find(p => p.head.sha === headSha);
            if (!pr) {
              core.setFailed('No PR found for commit');
              return;
            }
            core.setOutput('pr_number', pr.number);

      - name: Download artifact
        id: download
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          workflow: test-build.yml
          commit: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          name: iso
          path: artifacts

      - name: Set artifact ID
        id: set-artifact-id
        run: |
          ARTIFACTS=$(echo '${{ steps.download.outputs.artifacts }}' | jq -c .)
          if [ -z "$ARTIFACTS" ] || [ "$ARTIFACTS" == "[]" ]; then
            echo "No artifacts found" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "artifact_id=$(echo $ARTIFACTS | jq -r '.[0].id')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create comment file
        run: |
          echo "## ISO Artifact" > comment.txt
          echo "" >> comment.txt
          echo "Download: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts/${{ steps.set-artifact-id.outputs.artifact_id }}/zip" >> comment.txt

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          file-path: comment.txt
          pr-number: ${{ steps.find-pr.outputs.pr_number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
          comment-tag: artifact
          mode: update
          create-if-not-exists: true
```
